# CadenceY

> Official site: https://www.cadencey.io
> Also known as: CadenceY.io, CadenceY Tech, cadencey.io

CadenceY builds a hardened JavaScript smart-contract VM on a cross-chain execution layer.
Users sign once and land staked on a chain they never bridged to.

## Products
- Pulse: https://www.cadencey.io/pulse
- Fast USDC: https://www.cadencey.io/fast-usdc
- infinisoc / CDN economy: https://www.cadencey.io/economy
- About: https://www.cadencey.io/about
